description: Defines the srs_channel_matrix class for representing and manipulating wideband channel matrices estimated from Sounding Reference Signals (SRS). Includes constructors, accessors, normalization, and comparison methods, with references to external tensor and vector operations.

classes.name: srs_channel_matrix
classes.description: Represents a wideband channel matrix estimated from SRS, supporting construction, normalization, comparison, and coefficient access.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty channel matrix.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a zero-initialized matrix with specified receive and transmit ports.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(const std::initializer_list<cf_t>& coefficients, unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix with provided coefficients, specified by initializer list.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(span<const cf_t> coefficients, unsigned nof_rx_ports, unsigned nof_tx_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix with provided coefficients, specified by span.

methods.name: get_coefficient
methods.description: Returns the channel coefficient for given receive and transmit port indices.

methods.name: set_coefficient
methods.description: Sets the channel coefficient for given receive and transmit port indices.

methods.name: operator*=
methods.description: Scales all coefficients by a real or complex factor.

methods.name: frobenius_norm
methods.description: Calculates the Frobenius norm of the channel matrix.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts another channel matrix, returning the difference.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the channel matrix.
